findings.failure_scenario: Acceptance V7 runs python3 scripts/docs-impact.py --base origin/ecosystem-split --head HEAD. The three-dot range contains packages/skiller/lib/skiller/topology.py (D), packages/skiller/lib/skiller/profiles_list.py (A), packages/skiller/lib/skiller/topology_alias.py (A), and the interface edit packages/skiller/bin/skiller (M). The same guides still describe the shim as present: CONTRIBUTING.md:11 and docs/core/index.md:4-26, and packages/aicore/README.md:160-165 says core/__init__.py registers the old names and that a test checks every alias. rejected.reason: The stale `core/tests` instructions are real. They sit in CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/core/index.md and packages/aicore/README.md, none of which is in the write set. The write set covers only docs/architecture/**, docs/rejected-optimizations.md, CHANGELOG.md and the instruction sources. No acceptance check covers these files, and V6 greps only `*.py` for core imports. Fixing them would widen the scope. Record it as an open issue for a docs follow-up.
